description: Version-controlled evidence registry for the nanoparticle simulator. Every scientific value used anywhere in the tool must be traceable to an entry here. This file currently contains ONLY verified methodology/regulatory anchors. NO tissue-specific numeric parameters have been added: those require the Phase-2 evidence audit and explicit user approval (Phase 17 stop gate). Do not add a source unless its identifier (DOI/PMID/official document ID) has been checked against the actual source.

field_definitions.id: stable local key referenced by parameters and tissue profiles
field_definitions.type: one of: regulatory_guidance | modeling_platform | scientific_library | peer_reviewed_study | review_or_meta_analysis | mechanistic_model | parameter_database
field_definitions.title: exact title of the source
field_definitions.authors_or_issuer: authors, or issuing institution for guidance/software
field_definitions.identifier: DOI, PMID, or official document identifier
field_definitions.verified: true only if the identifier/URL was checked against the real source in this session
field_definitions.species: species the data pertains to, or N/A for methodology sources
field_definitions.provides_parameters: list of parameter names this source supports (empty until audited)
field_definitions.applicability_constraints: when these values may/may not be transferred
field_definitions.usage: how this source is used in the project

sources.title: Open Systems Pharmacology Suite (PK-Sim and MoBi)
sources.verification_note: Confirmed via web search 2026-07: open-source (GPLv2) whole-body PBPK platform; overview paper PMC6930856 (CPT Pharmacometrics Syst Pharmacol). Search results indicate NO documented dedicated nanoparticle-PBPK module.
sources.species: human + common lab animals (mouse, rat, dog, monkey, minipig, rabbit)
sources.nanoparticle_material: N/A (small-molecule and biologics focus; nanoparticle support not documented)
sources.applicability_constraints: Represents whole-body biodistribution, NOT the local intra-tissue diffusion the current simulator models. Candidate for a future backend only if nanoparticle support is added or custom-built.
sources.limitations: No documented nanoparticle class support; whole-body scope differs from this tool's local-diffusion scope.
sources.usage: Reference platform for the biodistribution scope discussion in docs/model-scope.md. Not currently a dependency.

sources.title: Physiologically Based Pharmacokinetic Analyses — Format and Content, Guidance for Industry
sources.verification_note: Confirmed via web search 2026-07: final guidance issued Aug 31 2018; Federal Register 2018-19065; recommends six-section PBPK report structure.
sources.applicability_constraints: Reporting/qualification framework, not parameter data. Informs how we label model status and report assumptions.
sources.limitations: Does not itself supply tissue parameters.
sources.usage: Basis for the model-status vocabulary (code-verified vs calibrated vs validated) and the assumptions/limitations reporting in docs/validation-report.md.

sources.title: Analysis of nanoparticle delivery to tumours
sources.authors_or_issuer: Wilhelm S, Tavares AJ, Dai Q, Ohta S, Audet J, Dvorak HF, Chan WCW
sources.verification_note: Confirmed via web search 2026-07: Nature Reviews Materials 1:16014 (2016); DOI 10.1038/natrevmats.2016.14; landmark finding of ~0.7% median administered-dose delivery to solid tumours.
sources.applicability_constraints: Aggregate delivery efficiency across heterogeneous studies; NOT a source of intra-tissue diffusion coefficients. Values must not be transferred across incompatible materials/species/routes.
sources.limitations: Reports delivered-dose fraction, not spatial diffusion parameters; heterogeneous underlying data.
sources.usage: Honest-framing anchor for the Evidence, Assumptions & Limitations panel (why tumour delivery is highly uncertain).

pending.note: Tissue-specific diffusion/permeability/clearance parameters are intentionally ABSENT. Populating them is Phase-2 work, gated on user approval. Each future entry must pass the verification checklist in docs/evidence-matrix.md before use.
